name: Ulka Gupta
bio: Ulka Gupta is an Indian actress who predominantly works in Hindi and Telugu films and television.

credits.title: 1857 Diary: The Hidden Pages
credits.overview: A film which highlights the role of a great leader as being the epi-center of the freedom struggle of India in 1857, against the British Empire.

credits.title: King
credits.overview: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

credits.title: Eetha
credits.overview: Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a renowned Marathi Tamasha and Lavani performer rises from humble beginnings to become one of Maharashtra's most celebrated folk theatre artists.

credits.title: Agadha
credits.overview: A solitary girl encounters a towering twelve-handed mystical idol in a torch lit shadowy cave, creating an atmosphere of spirituality and dark intrigue.

credits.title: Rajni Ki Baraat
credits.overview: A girl decides to take the reins of destiny in her own hands by organizing her own wedding procession after her boyfriend's egotistic and violent sadistic policeman father fixes his wedding somewhere else.

credits.title: The Kerala Story 2
credits.overview: Three young Indian women across different states choose love over tradition, only to become trapped. Their parallel lives show how romance and rebellion transform into control and silence, turning love into a weapon that destroys freedom.

credits.title: Simmba
credits.overview: A corrupt police officer enjoys all the perks of being an immoral and unethical police officer until an event which transforms his life completely and forces him to choose the righteous path.

credits.title: Rudhramadevi
credits.overview: Rudraba, daughter of Ganapatideva, the emperor of the Kakatiya dynasty, was officially designated a son through the ancient Putrika ceremony and given the name Rudradeva so that she could succeed her father after his death.
